messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

These symptoms also include dizziness and pounding heartbeat.
Other physical symptoms are also treated.
Buspirone is not an anti-psychotic medication.
It should not be used in place of medication prescribed by your doctor for psychotic disorders.

Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'is not about': The subject information page does not focus on the entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
